title: Juicy Tunisian Pears B'stilla
description: A flexible and flavorful dessert featuring a shio-koji-cured pear filling wrapped in crispy phyllo pastry.
instructions: Dust a large phyllo sheet with some all-purpose flour to prevent sticking.
Cut the phyllo sheet into a 12-inch square, and keep the remaining phyllo sheets covered with plastic wrap to prevent drying out.
Place a pear slice in the center of the phyllo square, leaving a 1-inch border around it.
Sprinkle a pinch of shio-koji powder over the pear, followed by a pinch of salt and a sprinkle of nutmeg powder (if using).
Fold the 4 edges of the phyllo square towards the center, pressing gently to seal the filling.
Brush the top of the phyllo pastry with melted butter, then sprinkle with a pinch of powdered sugar.
Repeat the process with the remaining phyllo sheets and pear slices, forming 6-8 b'stilla triangles.
Place the b'stilla triangles on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving about 1 inch of space between each triangle.
Drizzle the tops of the b'stilla with honey and sprinkle with crushed pistachios (if using).
Bake the b'stilla in the preheated oven for 20-22 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy.
Let the b'stilla cool on a wire rack for 5 minutes before serving.
Dust the b'stilla with powdered sugar before serving, if desired.
Serve warm or at room temperature, garnished with additional crushed pistachios and powdered sugar if desired
